Floral Heart Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Floral Heart because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+2766, which you can use as ❦ in HTML, \2766 in CSS, or type with Alt+10086 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Floral Heart is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+2766 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Floral Heart has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ❦ or the hex escape ❦.

How to type floral heart on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 0 0 8 6 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 10086.
  4. Release Alt. The Floral Heart character (❦) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type floral heart on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Floral Heart. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Floral Heart" and click the character to insert it.

How to use floral heart in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\2766"; ()
  • Python: \u2766 or chr(0x2766)
  • JavaScript: \u2766 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2766)
  • JSON: "\u2766"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ❦?

No legacy Alt code exists for Floral Heart because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+2766 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ❦ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ❦, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+10086 not work?

Alt+10086 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Floral Heart?

The Unicode codepoint for Floral Heart is U+2766. You can use this value in HTML as ❦, in CSS as \2766, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ❦ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2766, then click it.
